cohort: 195 pregnant women attending health centers in Amol-Iran, with 63 in the prenatal education group and 132 in the control group
finding: Prenatal education was associated with reduced anxiety, lower pain intensity during labor, and lower rates of episiotomy and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly lower in the prenatal education group (17.1%) compared to the control group (32.2%).
